content: Every tear that falls with sincerity washes the eye for a clearer vision of truth.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: Dust and grime inevitably coat our perception when we rush through worldly affairs. Grief, longing, and sincere repentance are heaven's water rinsing the spiritual retina. When you weep with genuine humility, you see the world with newfound tenderness and truth.
practicalInsight: Allow yourself to feel the tenderness of genuine emotion today. Do not hide behind cynical armor.
reflectionPrompt: What unwept tear are you holding back, and what clarity is waiting on the other side of honesty?
